source.name: PriceCharting public POP report
source.cadence: PriceCharting updates monthly; this site refreshes weekly.
source.graders: PSA and CGC columns as published. The page displays PSA+CGC combined per grade. Beckett/BGS is not collected.
source.half_grades: PriceCharting already buckets *.5 into the lower whole grade (8.5→8, 9.5→9). Raw half-grade rows are stored only when the HTML lists them.
source.prices: Indicative USD from the PriceCharting game page (not the POP table). used=raw, complete=Grade 7, new=Grade 8, graded=Grade 9, manual_only=PSA 10. Missing cells omitted, never invented. UI converts USD→HKD ×7.80.
